I teach the computing and analytics sequence in the Division of Business Administration —
students arrive with no programming background and leave able to pull data, model it, and
defend what the model says. All three courses are taught in a computer lab, and every
session is built around code that students run themselves.

## Office hours

By appointment. Email me at [hjkang@dongduk.ac.kr](mailto:hjkang@dongduk.ac.kr) with a
couple of times that work, and please say briefly what you would like to discuss so I can
come prepared.

## Advising

I supervise undergraduate research in AI policy, applied machine learning, blockchain and
on-chain data analysis, and empirical finance. The projects I enjoy most start from a
dataset nobody has looked at carefully yet — a public ledger, a permit filing, an
administrative record — and ask what it can be made to reveal.

If you would like to work with me, send a short note describing the question you want to
answer and any coursework or tools you have already picked up. Prior programming
experience helps but is not a prerequisite; curiosity about where the data came from
matters more.
